I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I really hear you on that. When you’ve been let down before, it makes it stressful to choose something new, especially for the garden.

A quick bit about our quality so you know what you’re getting:

All of our roses are grown by us in Oregon, on their own roots (not grafted), in 1-gallon containers with soil.
They are true to variety and virus-free, and we defoliate before shipping so they travel well and can put energy into new growth once planted.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors are here to help troubleshoot if anything seems off.
